purpose: Teach: 晒さ/信奉/軒並み/制圧/編纂/標榜/帰化/枯渇

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、戦時下の捕虜が晒された事案を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you wrote your paper on POWs during wartime and how they were exposed, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, observant tone. Genuine curiosity. Steady pace—the opening word rises slightly as if inviting confirmation, not challenging. Encouraging.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、特定思想の信奉者を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote about believers of a particular ideology.
lines.style: Direct and clear. A slight hesitation before answering—she's choosing her words carefully. Respectful but not deferential. Measured pace, light on the affirmation.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 商店が軒並み閉店した経済史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You wrote about local shops closing during that time, the economic history of it—that was your paper too?
lines.style: Gentle verification. Not interrogating, but reflecting back what she's hearing. Soft, interested tone. Slight lift at the end as if fitting pieces together.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、戦時下の制圧作戦を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I examined the suppression campaigns that took place during wartime.
lines.style: Calm, articulate. She's meeting the teacher's careful tone. No defensiveness—just stating what she studied. Steady, grounded delivery.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 古文書を編纂した学者の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you also wrote about a scholar's work compiling old manuscripts—that was one of your papers?
lines.style: Warm recognition. A slight wonder in the delivery—appreciating the breadth of her work. Conversational, not academic. Gentle rhythm.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、平和を標榜する組織の活動史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I looked at the history of organizations that promoted peace.
lines.style: Steady and clear. She's following the pattern of the dialogue—responding with focus. No rush. Slight confidence underneath—she knows what she's done.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 有名人の帰化事例を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Your paper on the naturalization of a public figure—that was another topic you chose?
lines.style: Reflective pause before speaking. Genuinely gathering threads. Interested, not probing. Soft opening, conversational rise.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、地下資源の枯渇問題を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote about the depletion of underground resources and what that means.
lines.style: Final affirmation. Clear and definite. She's brought the answer to completion. Slight settling quality—the end of a list that makes sense when you step back and look at it.
